Class Icons

java.lang.Object
com.store.inventory.ui.Icons
public final class Icons extends Object
Simple line-art icons drawn with SVGPath, all on a 16 by 16 grid.

The icons are coloured through CSS (style class icon), so they follow the light and dark themes automatically.

Author:
Mashal and Umaina
